# RS 3 protocol references

The ESP32 implementation is independently written against publicly documented DUML wire formats and capture samples. These MIT licenses are retained for attribution to the reference implementations:

- [b-rutledge-code/rs3mini-bridge](https://github.com/b-rutledge-code/rs3mini-bridge/tree/b64315754bb47be76d862ae8860764267215a7cf), copyright 2026 rs3mini-bridge contributors; see `rs3mini-bridge-LICENSE`.
- [jdesbonnet/dji_rs3_control](https://github.com/jdesbonnet/dji_rs3_control/tree/689884f2249e721c5b65c9c74804caddc1e7a68c); see `dji-rs3-control-LICENSE` for copyright and license terms.

Sources, model differences, wire details, implemented behavior and validation limits are recorded in [RS 3 Mini protocol](../../docs/design/rs3-mini-protocol.md). No vendor endorsement or official SDK support is implied.
